title: echium vulgare subsp. asturicum
intro: Echium vulgare subsp. asturicum, commonly known as the Spanish bugloss, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant has been used for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Echium vulgare subsp. asturicum are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
